name: What is AKN Design Group's process for designing a room addition?

mainEntity.name: What is AKN Design Group's process for designing a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for designing a room addition begins with a thorough consultation to understand your unique needs and lifestyle. We then develop detailed CAD-supported layouts and design plans that integrate seamlessly with your existing home. This managed process covers everything from initial concept development and material selection to structural considerations and interior finishes. AKN Design Group believes in harmonizing design vision with construction execution, providing you with a single, accountable team from the first drawing to the final walkthrough, ensuring your personalized solution is realized.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our room addition design process involves consultation, CAD-supported layouts, and detailed planning, integrating seamlessly with your home. We provide a single, accountable design-build team from concept to completion.
